[[File:Tele Block icon (mobile).png|left]]
'''Tele Block''' is a [[spell]] that requires a [[Magic]] level of 85 and can only be cast on another player in the [[Wilderness]]. 

When used, if it [[successful hit|successfully hits]] the target, a large purple sphere will emerge and collide with the target, applying the [[Status effect|status effect]] of the same name. The target will also be notified of the Tele Block being applied on them with the message {{mes|A Tele Block has been cast on you by [player name]. It will expire in [time].|colour=purple}} 

The default duration of the Tele Block is 5 minutes, but if the target had [[Protect from Magic]] up before it was cast and landed, it will be reduced by 50% to 2 minutes and 30 seconds. It should be noted that Protect from Magic does not affect the chance that Tele Block will splash. 

[[File:Skull_Tele_Block.png|left|The Wilderness level UI element as it appears while the player is under the effects of Tele Block.]]
While Tele Blocked, the player will be unable to use most forms of [[teleportation]], including the [[Wilderness Obelisk]]s and various teleport levers, such as the ones in the [[Deserted Keep]], [[Mage Arena]] and [[King Black Dragon Lair]]. They will also be unable to enter the [[Corporeal Beast]]'s cave or the [[Ferox Enclave]]. Exceptions to this rule are the [[Mage of Zamorak]] who can teleport the player to the [[Abyss]], and the [[Chaos Altar]] which can be entered with a [[chaos talisman]] or [[chaos tiara]]. Once Tele Blocked, the player is immune from further attempts until the current one expires. The player is briefly immune after the Tele Block wears off, though an observant player can quickly apply another one if timed properly.

There are various ways to remove the Tele Block:

*Kill the player who cast the Tele Block. When this occurs, the message "Your Tele Block has been removed because you killed [player name]." Forcing them to leave the Wilderness does not count.
*Leave the Wilderness by any means - jump over the [[Wilderness Ditch]] or [[death|dying]]
*Logging out, assuming the player is able to get out of combat.

In the Wilderness, the runes can be substituted with a [[Blighted teleport spell sack]].

[[File:Tele Block (fail).gif|thumb|250px|left|A failed cast of Tele Block.]]

==Trivia==
* Tele Block is the highest level spell available to [[free-to-play]] players.
* Several monsters are also capable of using Tele Block, such as the bosses of [[Mage Arena II]] and [[Elder Chaos druid]]s. The former's duration is 2 minutes (1 with Protect from Magic) and the latter uses the standard duration, but can cast it repeatedly and refresh its duration. This monster variant does not expire even if the caster is killed.
